description: Edit this sheet of eight small chibi pixel art figures: the top row walks towards the viewer, the bottom row walks away from the viewer. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit: a navy school blazer with a small gold crest on the chest, a white shirt and a red tie, grey plaid trousers and brown loafers. Seen from behind: the back of the navy blazer, grey plaid trousers and brown loafers. Simple bold shapes, no fine pattern. The hands stay bare. Transparent background, nothing else added.
